reviews.title: App and watch are glitchy
reviews.text: I’m such a big fan of Bark and everything they do. We’ve had the watch for 14 months and it has stopped reliably communicating with the app within the last month. I’ve been in touch with customer service about this and their solution so far has been to just buy another watch and they say it’s not their problem to fix. This isn’t a reasonable solution. The watch is insured but because it’s not broken, insurance doesn’t cover it but they don’t seem concerned about the tech not working. I’m going to give it another month but I may be canceling and switching to a different option if this doesn’t get resolved. I need to be able to track my 9 year old’s location for after school activities and if that feature isn’t working then I can’t stay with the brand which is really disappointing as I’d planned to stick with them through high school for both my kids and that may not be possible if the products and tech don’t work.

reviews.title: Confusing setup
reviews.text:
Cumbersome and not user friendly to set up safari monitoring. It would not recognize my daughters device even though all settings are proper.

You also have to utilize either a desktop app that needs to remain on and connected to WiFi, or a separate monitoring peripheral that you must purchase. None of this info is clear until after you agree to a subscription service. 

Extremely disappointing and frustrating.

Edit: thanks for the response and offer for support. I have an email chain that is 50 messages long with your support regarding overall confusion of setup and my end goal of simply monitoring safari activity. The agents provided conflicting information, furthering confusion over how this ridiculous app is supposed to function. I encourage you to read the entire support thread. This entire experience was a complete waste of time for a service that is misleading and confusing.

reviews.title: Truly awful
reviews.text: Bark’s ability to understand the context of absolutely ANY text conversation is truly terrible. They’re obviously keying off keywords only. Zero contextual understanding. Same for videos. Kids at a school dance? Sexual content. And bullying. Contact name of “Momma,” obviously a risky contact according to Bark. “Does this boy like me?” Well again that’s obviously bullying. Someone have a headache and mentioned in a text? Call 911 people. It’s medically concerning high alert. Even if all that wasn’t a problem, the laptop and phone agent almost never sync when on the same network. You have to plug the phone in for at least 45 min to do the analysis. If you ever want it. Horrendous app.

reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this company and would not recommend them.

The software itself has been unreliable. It frequently lags, and one of the main reasons for buying a kids’ smartwatch—being able to see your child’s live location—doesn’t work properly most of the time. The previous watch we had from them also used to ring randomly for no apparent reason.

On top of these technical problems, I returned the watch in good condition, but the company later charged me claiming that it was broken. To the best of my knowledge, there was no damage to the watch when I packaged and returned it.

Overall, I’m very unhappy with both the product quality and the way the return was handled. Based on my experience, I would be very cautious about buying from this company.

reviews.title: Reviewing app + phone
reviews.text:
We have had a bark phone since last August. While the monitoring is decent, we’ve had a few issues and I’m pretty over it at this point. 

If my child gets too many messages at a time, the phone lags badly and even freezes at times. If my child tries to mark a chat as “unread” so they can go back to it later, it won’t do it. If I give permissions to delete messages so we can clear the phone, the messages won’t actually delete. After the bark app glitched a few months back, some chats are available for my child to open no matter what routine I have set up for that time. The phone has been stuck on dark mode & battery saver mode since we got it and we don’t even have access on the phone to adjust battery settings. The longer we have the phone, the worse the location tracking is. And the most recent thing, a beta thing was added to the app. “Advanced insights” they call it. It is the most invasive addition to this and the fact that it is forced on us 1) without asking if we want to be part of it beforehand and 2) giving us the option to opt out makes it immensely worse. I’m just so disappointed in our experience.
